_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Heat remains coiled inside the Disbelief band with no confirmed breaker; base rate and analyst both favor HOLD until momentum/fear_greed/ETF flows actually impulse.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative supplies blowoff-top analog and flow reversal without a matching forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds the recent range and fear_greed, momentum, and funding stay roughly 45-65 with no ETF-flow or funding impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum and fear_greed both clear ~70 with ETF flows turning up (UP), or fear_greed <40 with CVD rolling over and price losing the range (DOWN)
